measurement: Tier-1 seconds cover evaluation after warmup, including tokenization, scoring, and subtask evaluation. Each worker loads one scorer, under the host GPU lock. Different implementations were timed separately. Score units per second equals correct answers divided by scoring time.
memory: Decimal GB. The combined harness figure is a snapshot after scoring. On the selected mixed runs, the harness scanned the staged package artifacts for clean model mappings. Any clean resident mappings backed by the stock Hugging Face cache are omitted, so these combined snapshots are lower bounds. The cache probe selected the stock snapshot directory; symlink targets outside that directory could also be omitted there. The process lifetime peak and MLX allocation peak are independent counters and are retained. Both stock adapters limit the MLX free buffer cache to 512 MiB.
timing_conditions: Watchdog monitored process-tree memory. The coordinators permitted background CPU activity; the M4 initial preflight detected macOS media analysis and a virtualization process. These single-run elapsed times carry no timing confidence interval.
per_item_encoding: 1,400 binary per-item scores in locked RAGTruth, CLINC150, RewardBench-2 order, packed most significant bit first into 175 bytes. Each item had a valid output.

laya.runtime: mlx-embeddings ModernBertModel, 8-bit weights, group size 64, BF16 head projections, FP32 scorer. Strict inner encoder load of all 170 tensors.

kev.runtime: mlx-lm 8-bit scorer and public pointer head. Uses only tokenizer.json from the original jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b adapter to match the project scorer.

laya_reference.model: PyTorch FP32 CPU reference with strict checkpoint load
laya_reference.checked: Every probability, exact option rank, token ID sequence and marker position on five inputs. Mixed question types share one padded stock batch, while the reference scored each example individually.

kev_cache_method: Eight locked RAGTruth records draw on two repeated source contexts. Each arm runs in a new process, warms on an unrelated input, measures the first scoring call, then repeats it. Project plain sets prefix_cache_mb=0 explicitly. One symmetric six-run schedule measures each arm twice. Seconds include tokenization, the full backbone and pointer head plus transfer of every option probability and raw logit.

kev.reason: The old worker loaded a second project scorer solely to format input. Its per-item scores are retained. Its time and memory include that configuration.
